description: Scrape Amazon third-party seller profiles and storefront catalogs. Provide one or more seller IDs directly, and/or product URLs to auto-derive the seller ID from the buy-box seller link.

categoryFilter.description: Optional. Narrow the storefront to one category or facet by pasting a refinement token (e.g. n:172282) or a full Amazon facet URL from the storefrontFacets record. Leave blank for the full storefront. (mode=PRODUCTS or BOTH)
categoryFilter.title: Category / Refinement Filter

feedbackPeriod.description: Time window Amazon applies to the individual feedback entries and the profile rating summary.
feedbackPeriod.title: Feedback Period

feedbackRating.description: Only include feedback entries with this exact star rating. 'All stars' returns every rating.
feedbackRating.title: Feedback Star Filter

includeBusinessDetails.description: If true, includes the seller's publicly-displayed legal business name, business address, and customer-service phone number (data Amazon itself shows on the public seller profile page -- not customer-level personal data).
includeBusinessDetails.sectionDescription: Controls the seller profile record. These fields apply only in PROFILE or BOTH mode.
includeBusinessDetails.title: Include Business Details

includeFeedbackEntries.description: Include the seller's recent individual feedback entries (star rating, text, rater, date) in each seller profile record, when Amazon displays them.
includeFeedbackEntries.title: Include Individual Feedback Entries

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace/domain to scrape sellers on. Overrides the domain inferred from productUrls when both are provided.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxFeedbackEntries.description: Maximum individual feedback entries to include per seller (Amazon returns 5 per page). Applies when Include Individual Feedback Entries is on.
maxFeedbackEntries.title: Max Feedback Entries Per Seller

maxProductPages.description: Maximum number of /s?me= storefront pages to fetch per seller (mode=PRODUCTS or BOTH). Each page holds up to ~16 products; Amazon stops pagination at the seller's own result count.
maxProductPages.sectionDescription: Controls the storefront product fetch. These fields apply only in PRODUCTS or BOTH mode.
maxProductPages.title: Max Storefront Pages Per Seller

maxProductsPerSeller.description: Hard cap on product records emitted per seller, applied in addition to Max Storefront Pages. (mode=PRODUCTS or BOTH)
maxProductsPerSeller.title: Max Products Per Seller

mode.description: PROFILE fetches only the seller profile page (including recent individual feedback entries when enabled). PRODUCTS fetches only the seller's storefront catalog. BOTH fetches both for every resolved seller.
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Amazon product page URLs (e.g. https://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN). The seller ID is auto-derived from each product's buy-box "sold by" seller link.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

proxyCountry.description: Optional geo-targeting override. AUTO follows the selected marketplace and needs no setup; the actor picks a working connection automatically.
proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country

sellerIds.description: Amazon seller/merchant IDs (e.g. A294P4X9EWVXLJ). Accepts bare IDs or IDs embedded in a seller/storefront URL.
sellerIds.title: Seller IDs

sortBy.description: Sort order for the seller's storefront catalog (mode=PRODUCTS or BOTH), matching Amazon's own storefront "Sort by" dropdown. Leave blank for Amazon's default (Featured).
sortBy.title: Storefront Sort Order

title: Amazon Seller & Shop Scraper Input
